svg.title: Hierarchical all-reduce on a 4-group Boardfly slice
svg.text: Hierarchical all-reduce on a 4-group Boardfly slice (128 chips)
reduce-scatter: tray: 3 peers in the tray, S/4 each, copper
reduce-scatter: group: 7 peers at the same tray position, S/32 each, over copper
reduce-scatter: global: 3 peers at the same chip index, S/128 each, over fiber
all-gather: global: 3 peers at the same chip index, S/128 each, over fiber
all-gather: group: 7 peers at the same tray position, S/32 each, over copper
all-gather: tray: 3 peers in the tray, S/4 each, copper
6 steps; dashed lines are fiber through the OCS. Dots move one hop per beat over minimal paths. Not to scale.
